Process 1. Each word makes three new vectors with a learned matrix each: a query (what am I looking for?), a key (what can I offer?) and a value (what do I pass on?).
2. The word’s query is compared with the key of every earlier word. The more they point the same way, the higher the score.
3. The scores become percentages that add up to 100 %.
4. The word takes a mix of all the values, weighted by the percentages. Nothing is sorted out completely, but a poor match gets a very small weight.
<span class=\"lb\">Resultat</span>Ett bi: ResultA contribution per word that is added to its vector. Now the word knows something about its context.
<span class=\"lb\">Varför</span>Det här: WhyThis is the only place in the whole model where words can affect each other. Without attention, every word would be handled in complete isolation.
Query = sökningen: <b>ett substantiv som: Query = the search: a noun that “den” can refer to. Keys = the video titles. Values = the content. “den” does not get a single video; it gets 62 % information about the cat, 27 % information about the mat, and a little of the rest. In the model, query, key and value are vectors, and the “titles” are not words but numbers.
Attention är modellens sätt att låta ord: Attention is the model’s way of letting words gather information from other words. It works roughly like a search, with one important difference: you do not get a single hit, but a mix of all of them, weighted by how well they match.

De två delarna i varje våning har helt o: The two parts of every layer have completely different tasks. Attention lets the words talk to each other, the MLP lets each word think on its own.

Modellen består av en enda konstruktion,: The model consists of a single construction, a block (also called a layer), that repeats. The count is called L. Llama-3-8B has L = 32.
Alla block har samma ritning: först atte: All blocks share the same blueprint: first attention, then the MLP. But each block has its own weights, so they learn to do different things.
Varför stapla? Ett block kan bara göra e: Why stack them? A block can only do one round of “fetch information from other tokens, process it”. Many conclusions need several rounds in a row, where each round builds on the previous one.

Att spara alla etiketter och innehåll ko: Storing all the labels and contents costs memory. GQA lets several queries share the same labels, which saves a lot of memory at a small loss of quality.
I klassisk Multi-Head Attention har varj: In classic Multi-Head Attention, every query head has its own K and V. Grouped-Query Attention lets a group of query heads share one KV pair.
Kvaliteten påverkas lite, men KV-cachen: Quality is barely affected, but the KV cache shrinks by a factor of n_h / n_kv. For Llama-3-8B that is a 4 times smaller cache, which leaves room for 4 times as many concurrent sequences.

Process 1. Expansion. The vector is compared with 14,336 learned patterns, one per neuron. In Llama that is done with two matrices in parallel: gate (does it match the pattern?) and up (how much should be passed on?).
2. Activation. SiLU on the gate works like a dimmer: neurons whose pattern matches are let through, the rest are damped almost to zero.
3. Projection. A third matrix, down, translates the neurons that lit up back into 4096 numbers.
<span class=\"lb\">Resultat</span>Ett bi: ResultA contribution that is added to the word’s vector: what the model “knows” about what was fetched.
<span class=\"lb\">Varför icke-linjär?</: Why non-linear?Without the dimmer, the three matrices would be just one matrix, and the model could not make decisions of the kind “if A and B, but not C”.

Nu bearbetas varje token för sig: vektor: Now each token is processed on its own: the vector is blown up, the patterns that fit are let through, and the result is squeezed back together.
MLP:n jobbar på varje token oberoende. D: The MLP works on every token independently. It expands to 3.5 times the width, lets a gate decide which of the 14,336 neurons are let through, and compresses back.

Neuroner som slår till skriver sin riktn: Neurons that fire write their direction into the stream, which makes some continuations more likely: resting animal → sov, vilade, låg; pet → morrhår, kisse, spann.
Varje neuron i MLP:n är en liten detekto: Every neuron in the MLP is a small detector looking for a particular pattern. If it finds it, it adds something to the word’s notes.
Varje neuron i MLP:n är en kolumn i W_ga: Every neuron in the MLP is a column in W_gate and a row in W_down. The column in W_gate is a pattern. The dot product with the token’s vector determines how well the vector matches the pattern.
En neuron som slår till skriver alltså s: So a neuron that fires writes its own direction into the stream. With 14,336 neurons per layer and 32 layers, there is room for a very large number of such rules.

Förenklad bild. Verkliga neuroner har sä: A simplified picture. Real neurons rarely have a clean human meaning; most respond to mixtures of many patterns, and one concept is often spread over many neurons (superposition).
